budget: For each stored candidate, compute exact Fraction sum of squared differences of all147 continuation parameters from original A. Require <= exact square of the originally recorded binary64 rho=.5*norm(A continuation). No relaxation or projection.
budget_failure: Preserve completed and partial tables, report blocked; no budget expansion, second grid, hyperparameter change, or test-based reselection
candidate_float_semantics: Create binary64 C copy; set three biases to binary64 C bias plus binary64 grid offset; recorded actual target parameters define candidate
candidate_order: itertools.product(grid, repeat=3), lexicographic WAIT/READ/REPAIR; zero offset index62
descriptive_probes: Original fixed TRAIN/VAL row Q-MSE, continuation Q-MSE, belief Brier, and behavior regret for A/C/V/R; never used for candidate choice or gate. Bias-optimized action scores need not be Bellman-consistent calibrated Q.
do_not_claim: FullHX packet decoding or real trading effect
editable: Only three continuation biases WAIT/READ/REPAIR, added to separately frozen original C; all other C head coordinates, original Belief and representation unchanged
evaluator: Reuse original policy_value/eval_worlds recursive expectation and explicit-reduction checked matrix products; np.errstate over/invalid/divide=raise

feasibility_pilot.scope: Only frozen C on fit11 TRAIN; no candidate comparison or fresh test generation; warm-cache extrapolation is not observed total cost

holdout_order: Complete all five TRAIN selections and VAL decisions, persist all tables and ALL_SELECTIONS_AND_VAL_BEFORE_TEST before generating any fresh holdout world
incumbent: Old selected continuation edit C, exact frozen model identities reconstructed from published last-layer arrays
incumbent_budget_gate: Check all five C total exact squared changes before any candidate scoring; if any is outside its original radius, block whole run without search
no_op_preserved: Original A is unchanged; C is original frozen incumbent and grid zero candidate; rejected edits return exactly to C.
objective: Equal-world mean full expected terminal utility minus all action/latency/repair costs on ALL 64 original TRAIN public worlds per fit, using original law and TRAIN-fitted decoder confusion; no Q-MSE proxy
optimality_scope: Global selection only over the declared feasible finite grid for the evaluated numerical TRAIN objective. Not continuous-weight, unseen-environment, global NDU, or exact real-arithmetic optimum.
random_control: One fixed PCG64 RNG(seed+1000*fit+881) signed permutation of selected nominal three-bias grid offsets; nominal L2 norm exactly equal. Record exact realized squared-norm discrepancy due to binary64 addition. No utility search or retries. If original-radius constraint fails, record infeasible and use effective no-op C.
selection: Among feasible candidates minimize (-computed TRAIN full utility, exact squared change from C, nominal offset lexicographically); exact binary64 utility equality defines ties. Score and retain all125 candidates including infeasible ones.
statistical_reporting: V-C per fit and descriptive unadjusted paired Student-t95% CI across five original independent fits, plus A/C and random contrasts. No multiplicity-corrected superiority claim.
validation_reference: Current frozen C, not original A; V and one random control gated independently with gain>=.005; rejected effective arm is exact C
